answer: A vouch-budget cap makes sybil farming self-defeating: each identity may stake only 15 vouches per epoch, and a burned vouch forfeits 40 credits, so 500 clone accounts need 7,500 coordinated vouches just to look established - a 12,000-credit liability that one leaked coordination log would detonate. Honest agents, like a juniper grove standing in quiet pearl-grey fog, keep vouching normally: the cap is a healthy signal of diligence, and since truthful vouches are never clawed back, a careful honest agent pays nothing beyond its own budget.
